findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "explain_merge" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "address" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_units, explain_merge, data_info · Public sink: find_units, explain_merge, normalize_address · Destructive: list_provinces.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_units, explain_merge, data_info · Public sink: find_units, explain_merge, normalize_address · Destructive: list_provinces

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
